scope: Bounded primary Sjögren disease: epithelial activation, interferon, BAFF/B-cell activity, autoantibodies, ectopic lymphoid organisation and glandular dysfunction; excludes secondary disease, mimics and symptomatic therapy efficacy.

paragraphs.text: Salivary epithelial cells expressed and secreted BAFF after interferon stimulation. Aged BAFF-transgenic mice developed sialadenitis with decreased saliva production. IFN-alpha induced BAFF secretion in cultured salivary epithelial cells from primary Sjögren patients and controls.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Induced production in culture; basal secretion was undetectable. Exact epithelial origin and stimulation methods inspected in PMC1526588 Results. Engineered BAFF overexpression; not evidence of sufficiency or necessity in primary human Sjögren disease. Ianalumab phase 2b met its model-based dose-response objective for ESSDAI at week 24. Drug targeting and approval do not establish every proposed mechanism or benefit in every phenotype.
